mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions marked by HOUST above 1200 thousand units and RSAFS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly, S&P 500 underperforms due to valuation pressures, producing negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the late-cycle expansion regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) trend over the past 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of rising INDPRO, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals an overheating economy with restrictive policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 3.5%), wage pressures drive inflation and trigger monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
